facts.fact: The Planning Data API provides access to more than 100 planning and housing datasets.
The entity endpoint supports JSON, HTML and GeoJSON extensions.
Coordinate searches require both longitude and latitude.
Coordinate searches return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point.
Multiple dataset parameters may be supplied in one request.
The documentation warns that absence of results does not mean no constraints exist because coverage varies.
A UPRN query can be more precise for registered properties.
The API supports geometry_entity filters.
The API supports geometry relations including within, intersects and disjoint.
The API supports pagination through limit and offset.
Dataset downloads may be available as CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Parquet.
The API is described as beta and may change for production users.
Local plan data may be supplied as CSV, GeoJSON, GML or GeoPackage.
Local plan data may also be served through OGC WFS or ArcGIS API.
Local plan boundary geometry should use WGS84 where possible.
An actual HTTP response is required before interpreting a coordinate query.
A client-side safe-URL refusal is not an API empty result.
A DNS error is not an API empty result.
Raw response body, request parameters and retrieval time are required for production evidence.
No exact future-growth relation is added because no candidate site-allocation geometry response was obtained.
